headline: Vet 💊 FEES CAPPED 🛑 at £21 🧾 Under New 📜 Rule Changes 🐶
text:
VETS 🐾 must now CAP 🛑 those PRESCRIPTION 💊 fees at a MAXIMUM 🛑 of £21 🧾 as part of a RAFT 🛶 of rule CHANGES 🔄 that practices 🏥 will be LEGALLY ⛓️ required to bring in over the coming MONTHS 📅!! The COMPETITION 🏆 watchdog 🐕 has brought these MEASURES 📏 into FORCE 💪 after its investigation 🔎 found vet PRICES 💰 had been rising at nearly TWICE 2️⃣ the rate of INFLATION 📈!! Critics 🗣️ say the moves will HIT 🥊 independent VETS 🐾 HARDEST 💥 and will mainly BENEFIT 🏆 the six FIRMS 🏢 that own more than TWO-THIRDS 2️⃣ of all PRACTICES 🏥, leaving the little guys getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 while the big boys get to SLAY 🗡️ the market!! "We got EDGED ⏳ for years on these prices" said one bystander 🧍‍♂️ watching the whole thing UNFOLD 📜 like a late-night negotiation that finally popped off at MIDNIGHT 🌙!!

VETS 🐾 also have to TELL 🗣️ clients if CHEAPER 💸 medicine 💊 is available ONLINE 💻, write out PRICE 📋 estimates ahead of any treatment, and PUBLISH 📢 full price LISTS 📋 for services as part of the rule UPDATES 🔄 coming in the next few MONTHS 📅!! The official COMPETITION 🏆 and MARKETS 🛒 AUTHORITY 📜 made its remedies for the sector LEGALLY ⛓️ BINDING 📌 as of TUESDAY 📅 and vets have up to TWELVE 1️⃣2️⃣ months to bring ALL 🌀 the changes in without getting FINED 🚫!! As well as CAPPING 🛑 those prescription fees the other CHANGES 🔄 include forcing practices to publish a COMPREHENSIVE 📋 price list for standard SERVICES 🛠️ including consultations 🩺, common PROCEDURES 🪛 and even CREMATION 🔥 options!! A written ESTIMATE 📝 must be provided in ADVANCE ⏩ for any treatment expected to cost £500 💰 or more including AFTERCARE 🩹 costs plus an itemised BILL 🧾 with emergencies 🚨 being the only EXCEPTION ❌ to this rule!!

VET 🐾 BUSINESSES 🏢 must make it CRYSTAL 🧊 CLEAR 📢 whether they are part of a big GROUP 👥 or an independent PRACTICE 🏥 so pet owners can actually KNOW 🤔 what they're walking into!! To help PET 🐶 owners compare LOCAL 🗺️ practices the PRICE 💰 and OWNERSHIP 👑 information will be made available through the ROYAL 👑 COLLEGE 🏫 of Veterinary Surgeons FIND A VET 🔎 service which will share the data with third-party COMPARISON ⚖️ sites so everyone can SHOP 🛍️ around like the thirsty deal hunters we are!! The TIMELINES ⏰ for when vets need to bring in the fixes depends on the exact REGULATION 📜 and the group's SIZE 📏 with the CMA spelling it all out in their official DOC 📑!! "The changes that are being REQUIRED 📢 are changes that will help INFORM 🧠 pet owners about PRICES 💰" said CMA panel CHAIR 🪑 Martin Coleman in his serious suit and tie getup!!

However CATE 🐱 TITTERTON the owner of an independent VET 🐾 service in SALTBURN 🏖️ told BBC 📻 Your Voice that these changes will actually make TRIPS 🛣️ to the vets more EXPENSIVE 💸 for customers in the long run!! "Veterinary practices still have to have a PHARMACY 💊 that is fully STOCKED 🧴 so if we're not making that tiny PROFIT 💵 on the drugs we're going to have to make some profit ELSEWHERE 🌍!! So things like SERVICES 🛠️ consultations 🩺 surgeries 🔪 unfortunately those prices are very very likely to have to GO UP 📈" she explained while looking down bad 😔 about the whole situation!! She believes there is ONE ☝️ clear WINNER 🏆 from this and it's the larger VET 🐾 groups and the CORPORATES 🏢 who are built different 💪 and ready to take the whole bag!!

BRITISH 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Veterinary Association PRESIDENT 👔 Dr Rob Williams said veterinary practices were already largely WORKING 💼 to the CMA's remedies including the orders relating to complaints HANDLING 🤝 price estimates for routine PROCEDURES 🛠️ and prescription COSTS 💰!! "We've been CLEAR 📢 with the CMA throughout its investigation that it must ensure its remedies do not DISPROPORTIONATELY ⚖️ impact smaller independent PRACTICES 🏥 and we've pushed back where we've had CONCERNS ⚠️" Williams said while standing firm like the unc 🧔 he is!! One person hoping to see a CHEAPER 💸 more TRANSPARENT 🪟 market for vet services is CLIVE 🐕 Di Giorgio who got in touch with BBC 📻 Your Voice after his nightmare experience!! He says he was quoted THOUSANDS 💰 of pounds for treatment after a vet told him that a rash on his dog LOUIS 🐶 back was DEFINITELY ✅ a sign of CANCER 🎗️!!

However after going to a DIFFERENT 🆕 vet surgery he says he was told LOUIS 🐶 rash was NOT ❌ cancerous at all and a treatment of steroids 💉 antibiotics 💊 and a SPRAY 🧴 cleared up the rash in TWO 2️⃣ weeks!! "You just don't feel as if when you go to the vets now they're interested in the ANIMAL 🐾" he says with serious side eye 👀!! "You feel as if all the interest is how much money they can basically SQUEEZE 🖐️ from you" he added while shaking his head at the whole greedy industry that left him and his pup down bad 🥲 for weeks!!
